verdict.rationale: CAM runs its own thought-leadership blogs on Indian legal developments, including India Corporate Law and Tax, and has published a detailed article on India's DPDP Rules 2025. That shows it publishes on the rules of its home market. No cached item addresses startup-specific instruments such as Indian ESOP or FDI rules, and the employment page explicitly has no ESOP page. Missing for 10: any publication on Indian ESOP or FDI startup rules, coverage of startup equity instruments, independent corroboration of startup-focused content.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE

citations.quote: We have created these blogs as part of our thought leadership initiative and to share key Indian legal developments and updates in an effective and user-friendly manner
India's digital privacy regime entered a new phase with the notification of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules, 2025.
